title: Questions 153-154 refer to the following text-message chain.
passage_1:
Priya Nandakumar (10:12 A.M.)
Hi, Tomas. Did you happen to see the piece posted on the CycleReport Web site this morning?

Tomas Berglund (10:13 A.M.)
No, I haven’t seen it. Why? Is there something important in it?

Priya Nandakumar (10:14 A.M.)
The writer was very impressed with our Kestrel X2 electric bike, which went on sale last month. The piece says that our light frame and quick-charging battery set a new standard for the industry.

Tomas Berglund (10:15 A.M.)
Really? That’s wonderful news! I’ll read the piece now.

Priya Nandakumar (10:16 A.M.)
Great. Could you pass this on to the rest of the sales team? We should take advantage of this attention for our coming promotional event.

Tomas Berglund (10:17 A.M.)
Will do. We’re gathering this afternoon.
